definitions.explanation: The blocking or clogging of small holes, pores, or openings in a filter, nozzle, drain, or similar device. Common in household maintenance and equipment troubleshooting contexts.

examples.japanese: フィルターの{目詰|めづ}まりを{掃除|そうじ}する。
プリンターの{目詰|めづ}まりで{印刷|いんさつ}できなくなった。
examples.english: The printer clogged up and I can't print anymore.

examples.japanese: エアコンのフィルターは{定期的|ていきてき}に{掃除|そうじ}しないと{目詰|めづ}まりを{起|お}こして{効率|こうりつ}が{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: If you don't clean the air conditioner filter regularly, it will clog up and efficiency will drop.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from {目|め} (holes, mesh) + {詰|つ}まり (clogging, blocking). The {目|め} here refers to the small openings in a mesh, filter, or nozzle. Often appears with を{起|お}こす (to cause) or する verbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目詰|めづ}まりを{起|お}こす (to become clogged)
- {目詰|めづ}まりを{解消|かいしょう}する (to clear a clog)
- {目詰|めづ}まりを{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent clogging)
- フィルターの{目詰|めづ}まり (filter clogging)
- ノズルの{目詰|めづ}まり (nozzle clogging)
